title: Characterization of the boundedness of the segment multiplier on rearrangement-invariant spaces
summary: Given a rearrangement-invariant (r.i.) space X, we show that the segment multiplier, the truncated Hilbert transform, and the discrete Hilbert transform (on the associated discretized space) are bounded on X simultaneously. Moreover, this boundedness is characterized by a condition on a pair of Boyd-type indices. We also exhibit an r.i. space on which the segment multiplier is bounded while the (non-truncated) Hilbert transform fails to be bounded.
